objective: Review this file for bugs. Report real defects only, most severe first.

samples.bug: Off-by-one: the loop uses <= with an exclusive end, so every page gets one extra (or undefined) item.
Missing await on fetch: res is a Promise, so res.ok is always undefined.
SQL injection: the customer name is interpolated into the query with an f-string.
Units: percentOff is 0-100 but is used as a fraction, so a 10% discount makes the price negative.
The give-up check is unreachable after continue, so a persistent TransientError retries forever.
Inverted expiry check: fresh entries are deleted and expired ones are returned.
re.match without an end anchor accepts '123456' or '12345abc'.
jwt.decode does not verify the signature or expiry, so anyone can forge an admin token.
Array.prototype.sort() without a comparator sorts numbers as strings (10 before 9).
new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') is UTC midnight but getDay/getDate read local time: off by a day west of UTC.
average_stock divides by zero on an empty history.
